title: Return a data object
summary: FastAPI: Return a data object. Add an author field.
introduction: A Python dictionary becomes JSON. Open GET /book. Read the example, then check the result.
learningObjectives: Return a data object with FastAPI

blocks.text: Install fastapi and uvicorn with python -m pip install fastapi uvicorn. Save one example as app.py and run uvicorn app:app --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8000. Use the stated route on that address.

blocks.title: Return a data object

blocks.text: FastAPI serialises the returned Python dictionary as JSON.

blocks.title: Watch out
blocks.text: Return Python data instead of manually joining JSON strings.
